recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not re-add the DiagnosticReport intro Event sentence unless OO reverses or narrows FHIR-53501; if a more visible narrative Event declaration is desired, raise a fresh work-group issue so it can be reconciled with the later ballot-note decision.
issue_request: FHIR-50597 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 OO issue asking whether DiagnosticReport's scope sentence about intending to align with workflow Event resources meant the alignment had not been done. The approved resolution said DiagnosticReport now implements the Event Pattern and the stale intent sentence should be changed to current event-resource wording.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 01272656b026a4b5c77cb7428494b6b42ca75419, which edited source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-introduction.xml. That commit removed the stale intent clause, but the resulting introduction duplicated event-resource prose.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml maps DiagnosticReport itself to Event and includes the later FHIR-43443 Event.category and Event.note mappings. Later Applied issue FHIR-53501 explicitly removed the duplicated event-resource introductory text and added the R6 ballot note that is now present. Confluence references show OO minutes for DiagnosticReport workflow pattern alignment, and corrected Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding the FHIR-50597 replacement sentence would conflict with later Applied issue FHIR-53501, while the original misleading future-tense intent sentence is absent and the authoritative workflow mappings remain present.
